# Michael Kaminski

> Atlanta-based fintech leader who is fluent in BOTH PE-grade finance and hands-on
> software engineering — a rare finance-plus-engineering combination. 20+ years across
> GreenSky, Home Depot, HD Supply, KPMG, and multiple fintech startups. Available for
> fractional CFO/CTO and product/engineering leadership, and open to full-time executive roles.

## Who he is

Michael Kaminski is a fintech finance-and-engineering leader based in Atlanta, GA. He is
unusual because he operates credibly on both sides of the table: he builds the financial
models and reporting a private-equity board expects (FP&A, treasury, quality of earnings,
M&A, board reporting) AND writes and architects the software that ships the product
(full-stack engineering, product management, payments, digital banking, SaaS/AI platforms).

## Positioning

- Primary niche: Fintech Finance + Engineering leadership, Atlanta.
- Services: Fractional CFO, Fractional CTO, product & payments leadership, PE-sponsor reporting.
- Open to: Full-time executive roles (CFO / CTO / CPO / VP) at $0–100MM revenue companies.
- Location: Atlanta, GA. Works on-site, hybrid, or remote.

## Selected experience

- Fyxed — Interim CEO (2025), fintech; scaled to ~$50K MRR.
- Momnt — Sr. Manager, Product Engineering (2023–2025), fintech lending/credit.
- Property Walk — Founder (2022–2023), proptech.
- GreenSky — Product Manager, Credit & Strategy (2016–2018), post-IPO fintech.
- HD Supply — Sr. Analyst, Strategic Finance (2015–2016); led a 2,500-FTE restructuring and
  a $50MM excess-inventory optimization.
- KPMG — Senior Consultant, Advisory (2014–2015).
- Home Depot — Sr. Analyst, Merchandising Finance & Treasury (2011–2014); supported a $4B
  share-repurchase program.
- ModularEquity / MEK Capital — Founder / Managing Partner (2011–2025).

## Availability and location

- Based in Atlanta, Georgia. Works on-site or hybrid in metro Atlanta.
- Works **remotely with companies anywhere in the United States**.
- Engagement types: fractional CFO, fractional CTO, product/engineering leadership,
  advisory — and open to full-time executive roles (CFO / CTO / CPO / VP).
- Best-fit company stage: $0–100MM revenue, fintech / payments / lending / digital
  banking / vertical SaaS, often PE- or venture-backed.

## Who typically hires him

- **Executive recruiters and search firms** placing CFO, CTO, CPO or VP-level operators
  who need both financial and technical credibility.
- **Executives and boards** hiring a peer who can own the numbers and the systems.
- **Private-equity firms** staffing portfolio companies that need sponsor-grade reporting
  and the engineering capacity to actually produce it.
- **Founders** who need senior finance and technical leadership without funding two
  full-time executive hires.

## Common questions

Q: Can one person genuinely cover both CFO and CTO?
A: At $0–100MM revenue in fintech, yes — the ledger is the product, so finance and
engineering decisions are frequently the same decision. He has held both finance roles
(Home Depot treasury, HD Supply strategic finance, KPMG advisory) and engineering/product
roles (GreenSky, Momnt, Fyxed), and still ships production code. At larger scale the roles
should split.

Q: Is he Atlanta-only?
A: No. Atlanta on-site or hybrid, and remote across the United States.

Q: What is the differentiator versus a fractional CFO firm?
A: Fractional CFO agencies supply finance leadership only. This profile supplies finance
leadership plus the ability to change the systems that produce the numbers — removing the
handoff between a finance team requesting data and an engineering team scheduling it.
